author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Here are 5 new ways to use ChatGPT’s 5 new features 👇

1. Use GPT-6’s upgraded computer use to turn you workspace into a digital diorama in Blender.
2. Use GPT Image 2.5 to redesign one corner of a room while preserving the rest.
3. Use ChatGPT Work’s cloud browser to check your AI subscriptions across websites you’re signed into and build a dashboard of costs and renewal dates.
4. Use GPT-Live 1 to build a travel planner you can talk to while it researches.
5. Use The Agents API to build a guitar-practice coach that remembers your progress between sessions.

🔗 Head to the link in the pinned comment to download @OpenAI Codex and try these prompts for yourself!

title: 5 Prompts For Every ChatGPT New Feature
